data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 框架把完成轨迹抽象为过程记录，在任务块间固化并供后续决策复用技能库与记忆经验；骨干固定，属外部工件持续改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Completed trajectories are abstracted into process records and consolidated between task blocks
scope_support.object_quote: A Spatial Skill Library provides reusable tool procedures, and Spatial Cognition associates task conditions with experience about when and how to use memory and skills.
scope_support.persistence_quote: allowing later decisions to draw on earlier execution without transferring scene coordinates or reference answers
